name_input: DATWYLER PHARMA PACKAGING INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs record, 2025-08-25: Supplier 'DATWYLER PHARMA PACKAGING INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED' -> Buyer 'DATWYLER PHARMA PACKAGING BELGIUMNV', goods 'MOULD V9154 G', origin 'MAHARASHTRA INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION SATARA SEZ, India', destination 'BRUSSEL BRUXELLES, BELGIUM', HS 84807900, BOL 6713472. Source counter: page header states 'Total Shipments 5 Records detected'; rows actually seen on page = 5 (1 outbound to Belgium + 4 inbound: 2 from SCHMALZ LIMITED UK on 2026-01-24 HS 84819090 / 39269099 BOL 7105933, 2 from JING DAY MACHINERY TAIWAN on 2024-05-25 HS 84779000 BOL 3657844). Counter matches rows seen.
note: Export side is factually confirmed but thin: exactly one outbound customs record (2025-08-25, Satara SEZ -> Belgium, HS 84807900 moulds, BOL 6713472) — and it is an intra-group shipment to the parent's Belgian entity, not a third-party sale. The other 4 of 5 records are imports (UK gaskets/clamps, Taiwan machinery parts), i.e. the Indian entity is predominantly an importer in the visible data. Declared HS 401699 (rubber articles) does not match the observed export line (84807900, moulds for rubber) nor the import lines (84819090, 39269099, 84779000); per project rules this is not a rejection ground — actual HS should be corrected to the observed codes. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report India split) could NOT be verified: DuckDuckGo/searx search returned 'Connection refused' on both attempts, and volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403. No domestic figure is asserted; field left null rather than estimated. No revenue or export value figures are public in the free views, so those remain null. No sanctions/court/ownership issues assessed here (out of scope for this role).
